integrity: Complete self-contained deductive proof and two independently programmed finite enumeration crosschecks embedded; the finite checks support but do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem counts noncancelling unordered cubic frequency triples, not unrestricted convolution coefficients, Bessel integrals, or sharp Fourier extension constants. Historical priority subject to unindexed signed-digit literature.
title: Sharp eightfold primitive triple-sum collisions in the symmetric dyadic Fourier spectrum
